facts.business: Elgi Rubber Company Limited manufactures rubber products including reclaim rubber and operates in the rubber industry.
key_risks: Economic conditions affecting demand/supply and price conditions in domestic and overseas markets
Changes in Government regulations, policies, fiscal laws and other statutes
Impairment of investment, loans and receivables relating to step-down foreign subsidiary Rubber Resources B.V., Netherlands under liquidation
Uncertain tax positions involving significant judgment
Credit risk from trade receivables and financial instruments
